payload.contract: parent selects proof debt and exact owner ranges; child reasons only over embedded numbered source
isolation: child working directory has no repository path
no tools, issues, PRs, history, or internet in prompt
whole process group terminated on timeout
provider_contract: default available model; no hard-coded unsupported model

provenance.source: tools/txnlab/scout.py and packet scout runs on pinned transaction source

name: Compile owner source packet before AI reasoning

steps: select one proof debt and highest consumer
map mutation, durable, recovery, and publication owners
reject packet above hard limits before launch
verify every proposed owner transfer in source
admit only a product-reachable C3 card
stop_rules: do not let child search the repository
timeout is INVALID budget evidence, not a negative conclusion
do not accept child ownership claims without direct verification
recompile packet before increasing wall time

name: Persisted async marker prevents unsafe ordinary cleanup after fallback

payload.source_shape: a prewrite request was sent in async mode before another batch changed the committer's current mode
payload.holding_guard: TiKV persists use_async_commit in accepted locks; CheckTxnStatus and recovery inspect durable lock mode, and non-async evidence triggers force-sync handling rather than assuming ordinary cleanup owns an async outcome
payload.retired_direction: request-mode/current-mode mismatch alone causes partial rollback or false terminal truth
payload.highest_consumer: no all-or-none row-image or terminal-result divergence survived the durable marker owner graph

provenance.source: pinned client-go prewrite/fallback and TiKV CheckTxnStatus/resolve paths

name: Lost LockedWithConflictTS is bounded to residual pessimistic lock

payload.source_shape: TiKV force-lock succeeds with actual forUpdateTS above the request, but the response carrying LockedWithConflictTS is lost; client rollback uses a lower threshold
payload.holding_guard: TiKV correctly preserves the higher-generation lock; transaction heartbeat eventually stops and TTL/status resolution removes it
payload.highest_consumer: temporary lock availability and extra wait; no committed data loss, atomicity break, false terminal result, or unrecoverable liveness found
payload.reopen_only_if: a consumer proves the orphan lock remains live beyond heartbeat/TTL or is committed under the wrong owner

provenance.source: pinned client-go LockKeys rollback TODO and TiKV pessimistic rollback predicate

name: Pipelined exclusive-end eager cleanup omission has read and GC recovery owners

payload.source_shape: pipelinedEnd stores the maximum flushed key itself while RangeTaskRunner scans an exclusive end; a Region beginning exactly at that key can be omitted from eager resolveFlushedLocks
payload.holding_guard: the primary terminal status remains authoritative; ordinary reads resolve the secondary lock and GC performs mandatory lock resolution before advancing safepoint
payload.highest_consumer: residual secondary lock and delayed cleanup, not durable data loss or false commit truth
payload.reopen_only_if: a highest consumer bypasses both ordinary lock resolution and pre-GC resolve

provenance.source: pinned client-go pipelined bounds/range task and lock-resolution owners

name: Lock resolver caches only durable determined transaction status

payload.source_shape: client-go caches transaction status by startTS and treats NoAction as rollback
payload.holding_guard: TiKV maps NoAction only from an existing durable rollback record; LockNotExistDoNothing and pessimistic rollback actions are not StatusCacheable; primary mismatch returns to owner-specific cleanup
payload.retired_direction: provisional pessimistic-primary state poisons the transaction-level terminal cache
payload.highest_consumer: no false commit/rollback decision or wrong read-access classification found

provenance.source: pinned client-go lock_resolver.go and TiKV check_txn_status action/response mapping

name: Fair-lock delayed cleanup retains an older forUpdateTS threshold

payload.source_shape: a prior fair-lock attempt leaves a key in lastRetryUnnecessaryLocks and cleanup is asynchronous while a later attempt may need the key again
payload.holding_guard: a referenced key is removed from the rollback set before retention; failed-attempt rollback captures that attempt's timestamp; TiDB publishes a new retry timestamp to transaction context/snapshot first, and client-go committer receives it only in later LockKeys; TiKV deletes only lock.for_update_ts <= rollback_ts
payload.adversarial_screen: packet scout proposed a three-attempt same-TS deletion but conflated TiDB context mutation with client-go committer mutation
payload.highest_consumer: no reachable loss of a later lock generation

provenance.source: TiDB RR retry ordering, client-go aggressive lock set rotation, TiKV pessimistic rollback predicate

name: Commit Region relocation re-identifies primary by key

payload.source_shape: a commit batch carrying the primary receives a Region error and its mutations are regrouped after split or relocation
payload.holding_guard: client-go calls doActionOnMutations on the mutation subset, rebuilds batches, and setPrimary locates the primary key again; the old isPrimary bit is not copied into every child
payload.retired_direction: secondary success is mislabeled as primary commit and suppresses unknown-outcome handling

provenance.source: pinned client-go commit.go and 2pc.go batch regrouping
provenance.introduced_for: primary terminal identity across topology change

rationale: The tool enforces the schedule's source and wall-clock budgets.
Source reasoning must produce a verified owner card before any fault-altitude execution.
Durable lock mode dominates mutable current-mode inference during recovery.
A hidden higher forUpdateTS preserves rather than destroys the newer lock and currently reaches only TTL-bounded availability.
Read and GC owners dominate the eager cleanup range omission.
Only durable determined status enters the transaction-level cache.
Timestamp publication order and TiKV comparison protect later generations.
Regrouping recomputes primary identity before terminal handling.

name: IMPORT INTO post-success cancelled context is not promoted to terminal failure

payload.source_shape: IMPORT INTO waits for a DXF task to succeed, then calls fillJobInfo with the original request context
payload.probe: real-TiKV deterministic cancellation after waitTask success and before fillJobInfo
payload.observed: the imported rows were durable and the SQL returned success; the internal job lookup did not turn the cancelled context into a public error
payload.holding_guard: the suspected post-effect consumer is not fallible under this cancellation producer on the tested path
payload.reopen_only_if: a supported producer reaches an exact later consumer that returns a definite public error after task success

rationale: A post-effect context-bearing call is not a candidate until cancellation reaches the public terminal error.
